mail.disabled.title: Mail is not enabled for your account
mail.disabled.text: An owner or administrator enables Mail for your account under Users › Account › Apps.
mail.empty.title: No mailbox yet
mail.empty.text: Set up a mailbox with its address and password. Only your account sees it.
mail.live.down: No live connection to the NAS – new e-mail shows up again once it is back. Mail reconnects by itself.
mail.noneOpen: No message open. Choose one on the left.
mail.search.label: Search this folder
mail.filter.label: Show
mail.list.heading: {folder} · {account}
mail.images.blocked: External images blocked – they would tell the sender that and when you open the message.
mail.truncated: The message is very large: parts are shortened or left out. The attachments are above.
mail.rawText: This mail is too large in structure to be prepared (for example a digest with a great many posts). Mail shows the beginning of its content as it came – without formatting and without attachments.
mail.link.title: Link targets in this message ({count})
mail.link.someWarn: Careful: a link leads somewhere other than its text says
mail.link.warn: The text names another address – the link leads to {host}
mail.attachment.title: Attachments
mail.move.title: Move to …
mail.delete.title: Delete for good?
mail.delete.text: The message “{subject}” is in the trash.
mail.delete.forever: It is deleted for good at the provider and cannot be brought back.
mail.compose.title: New e-mail
mail.compose.subject: Subject
mail.compose.invalidHint: At least one address is not valid. Remove it or type it again.
mail.compose.discardDraft: What you wrote is lost, and the saved draft goes to the trash.
mail.compose.draftAuto: The draft is saved every 30 seconds while you write.
mail.compose.noAccount: Choose the mailbox you write from.
mail.compose.tooLarge: The attachments add up to {size}; at most {max} are allowed.
mail.setup.title: Set up mailbox
mail.setup.intro: Mail connects through IMAP and SMTP, always encrypted (TLS). The password is kept encrypted on the NAS and never shown on a page again.
mail.setup.name: Name of the mailbox
mail.setup.nameHint: What Mail calls the mailbox, e.g. “Personal”. Empty: the address.
mail.setup.badAddress: That is not a complete e-mail address.
mail.setup.known: {name} is known; the servers are already filled in.
mail.setup.unknown: Mail knows no servers for {domain}. Enter them as your provider names them.
mail.setup.tlsOnly: Encrypted connections only; the server's certificate must be valid.
mail.setup.appPassword: This provider wants an app password: a password only for Mail that you create in your account settings at the provider. Your normal password does not work here.
mail.settings.title: Settings
mail.settings.authFailed: The login at the provider failed. Mail tries again only after you change the password, user name or server.
mail.settings.passwordKeep: leave empty: stays as it is
mail.settings.passwordHint: Leave empty to keep the stored password.
mail.settings.removeHint: Removes the mailbox from Mail. Nothing changes at the provider.
mail.settings.removeText: Mail forgets “{name}” with its servers, password and the rules for this mailbox.
mail.settings.removeKeeps: Your e-mail stays at the provider; you can set the mailbox up again at any time.
mail.settings.notifyDesc: Bell and push for new e-mail in the inbox, per mailbox.
mail.settings.signaturesDesc: Text below your e-mails. Which one a mailbox uses by default is set at the mailbox.
mail.settings.rulesDesc: Run on the NAS for new e-mail in the inbox, in order.
mail.settings.rulesNew: Rules apply only to e-mail that newly arrives, not to existing mail.
mail.signature.name: Name
mail.signature.removeText: The signature “{name}” is deleted once you save.
mail.rule.subject: Subject contains
mail.rule.removeText: The rule “{rule}” is deleted once you save.
error.mail_disabled: Mail is not enabled for your account.
error.mail_auth_failed: Login at the mail server failed: the user name or password is wrong (some providers need an app password).
error.mail_unreachable: No connection to the mail server: not reachable, refused, no secure connection or no answer. Check the server, port and encryption.
error.mail_unavailable: Mail is not ready on this NAS right now. Try again in a moment.
error.mail_tls: No secure connection: the server offers no TLS or its certificate is not valid.
error.mail_host_forbidden: This server is not allowed: only mail servers on the internet. Only an administrator may enter servers in the home network; the NAS itself never.
error.mail_timeout: The mail server did not answer in time.
error.mail_too_large: Too large: attachments may add up to at most 25 MB.
error.mail_not_found: The message or folder is no longer there.
error.mail_folder_exists: A folder with this name already exists.
error.mail_send_failed: The mail server did not accept the e-mail.
users.apps.mailHint: Off from the start, for owners and administrators too. Each mailbox is seen only by the account that sets it up.
mail.setup.senderNameHint: Shown to recipients before your address, e.g. “Alex Example”. Empty: the address alone.
mail.setup.unsupported: {name} no longer accepts a password, only signing in with the provider (OAuth). Mail cannot do that in this version.
mail.settings.passwordAgain: Server or user name changed: enter the password again. A stored password never goes to another server.
mail.settings.pushContent: Sender and subject in push messages
mail.settings.pushContentDesc: Off: push messages only say “New e-mail in <mailbox>”. The bell never names sender or subject.
mail.hint.imap_enable: {name}: allow access through IMAP/POP3 in your mailbox settings at the provider.
mail.hint.app_password: {name}: create an app password for Mail in your account at the provider and enter it here.
mail.hint.app_password_2fa: {name}: with two-step sign-in you need an app password, which you create in your account at the provider.
mail.hint.mail_password: {name}: use the separate password for e-mail programs, not that of your customer account.
mail.hint.oauth_only: {name} requires signing in with the provider (OAuth), which Mail cannot do yet.
notify.kind.mail_new.title: New e-mail
notify.kind.mail_new_many.title: New e-mails
error.mail_password_required: The server or user name was changed: enter the password again. A stored password never goes to another server.
error.mail_no_password: No password is stored for this mailbox. Enter it in the settings of the mailbox.
error.mail_settings_unreadable: The Mail settings of this account could not be read at start. So that nothing is lost, Mail saves nothing over them.
error.mail_rate_limited: Too many tries with new servers or connection checks – please wait a minute.
error.mail_busy: Mail is busy with other large requests (sending, attachments). Try again in a moment.
error.mail_key_missing: The key of the stored mail passwords is missing on the stick. Restore it from the backup of the stick or add the mailboxes anew.
error.mail_key_damaged: The key of the stored mail passwords is damaged. Restore it from the backup of the stick or add the mailboxes anew.
users.agentData.mailAccounts: Mail mailboxes ({count}) with servers, passwords, signatures, rules and address book
mail.limit.wait: Too many attempts with new servers or connection checks – Mail waits another {seconds} s; “Check connection” works again after that.
mail.resize.hint: Drag or use the arrow keys to change the width; a double click resets it.
mail.quick.label: Quick actions
mail.bulk.label: Actions for the selection
mail.bulk.deleteText: The messages are in the trash. They are deleted for good at the provider and cannot be brought back.
mail.scope.label: Search in
mail.search.fromHint: Name or address of the sender
mail.search.attachmentHint: Finds mail with attached files. A mail that is a file and nothing else is not found.
mail.search.needCriteria: Type a search or choose a filter to search all folders.
mail.search.truncated: Not every folder was searched. Narrow the search, for example with a period.
mail.keys.title: Keyboard shortcuts
mail.keys.note: The keys do nothing while you type in a field.
mail.fav.title: Favourites
mail.drop.other: Only into folders of the same mailbox
mail.overview.title: Overview
mail.overview.hint: Choose a message in the list to read it here.
mail.overview.live: New mail in the inbox arrives by itself.
mail.overview.poll: The list reloads every 2 minutes while Mail is open.
mail.keys.global: The other keys of TitanOS, such as Ctrl+K, still work here.
